budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Scouts coordinate local sensors, finite pulses, physical beacons and tags to capture the two player-controlled runners; runners use routes, smoke, jams and exits.
task.natural_termination: Both runners resolved as captured or escaped, otherwise horizon seventy-two. Captured and escaped runners are inactive and may only wait. Capture precedes simultaneous escape. Natural completion takes priority at the horizon.
task.interaction: A directional pulse shares a live runner track with the other scout. Beacons expose nearby runners even through smoke. Runner smoke cancels pulse tracking, and physical jams defeat simultaneous activation. Tags and escapes change both teams' rewards; finite tokens compete between information actions and dashes.
task.observation_access: Fixed map, beacons, exits and aggregate resolved counts are public. Teammates share exact state. Scout zero senses Manhattan one plus a horizontal three-cell beam, scout one Manhattan one plus a vertical three-cell beam. Runners sense Manhattan two. Sensors ignore wall occlusion by explicit radio-rule convention. Pulse tracks and beacon coverage are shared only with scouts. Smoke blocks non-adjacent ordinary scout sensing and cancels pulse tracks; beacons pierce it. Hidden payloads are minus one.

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
